themes.label: GitHub
themes.description: Primer — the calibrated, low-chroma default. Neutral surfaces, colour only where it means something.

themes.label: Graphite
themes.description: Near-monochrome instrument panel. Achromatic surfaces, one saturated colour at a time — colour means status, nothing else.

themes.label: Carbon
themes.description: Near-black with warm neutrals and a single signal green. The register of the current agent desktop apps.

themes.label: Clay
themes.description: Warm ceramic neutrals and terracotta. Paper in the light, ink in the dark — the least screen-like of the set.

themes.label: One
themes.description: The Atom lineage — balanced slate blues with warm syntax. The most widely installed dark theme there is.

themes.label: Dracula
themes.description: Bright pastels on deep violet-grey. The loudest theme here, and the most recognisable.

themes.label: Tokyo Night
themes.description: Deep indigo night with neon signage. Cool surfaces, saturated accents, strong separation between chrome and content.

themes.label: Catppuccin
themes.description: Soothing pastels on deep violet-grey. Low chroma contrast, high hue variety — easy on long sessions.

themes.label: Ayu
themes.description: Gold on near-black. High-chroma accents over a very dark, very neutral ground.

themes.label: Night Owl
themes.description: Deep navy tuned for low light, with hues separated by luminance as well as by colour.

themes.label: Rosé Pine
themes.description: Muted plum and dusk rose. Warm, low-saturation and quiet — the least "terminal-looking" of the set.

themes.label: Nord
themes.description: Arctic, blue-shifted and deliberately desaturated. The quietest of the six — built for long, low-glare sessions.

themes.label: Everforest
themes.description: Desaturated forest green with soft warm accents. The only green-grounded palette here, and the easiest on tired eyes.

themes.label: Gruvbox
themes.description: Retro groove — warm earth tones on tinted paper or brown-grey. The most forgiving light variant in the set.

themes.label: Solarized
themes.description: The original precision palette — one set of hues, two symmetric backgrounds. Light and dark are genuinely the same theme.

themes.label: Flexoki
themes.description: Analog printing inks on warm paper. Built for reading — the calmest option for long transcripts.

themes.label: High Contrast
themes.description: Targets WCAG AAA, not AA — 7:1 body text and full-strength borders. For low vision, glare, or a failing monitor.
